settings.title: Jewelry Care
settings.content:
Our jewelry is made with love and can be worn daily, however, it should be handled with care! 

To ensure longevity, we recommend the following:

- Remove all demi-fine jewelry before showering, swimming, and sweating. Our waterproof & fine jewelry can handle those activities, but should still be handled with care. 

- Rings should be removed before exercising and any other strenuous activity using your hands.

- Apply perfume, lotion, and hairspray on first, then your jewelry.

- Store your chain jewelry in your EMBARK pouch with the clasp left out to prevent tangling.  

- Clean your fine jewelry with our bestselling jewelry cleaning products, otherwise, warm water, mild soap and a delicate toothbrush will do the trick! 

Please be aware that due to the unique nature of the materials used - colors, shapes, and sizes may vary slightly from the images and descriptions. 

Embark is not responsible for any damages after 60 days.
